q: How do I reset my password?
answer: On the sign-in page, click "Forgot password". We email a reset link that expires after 30 minutes. Make sure to check your spam folder, as the email might be misclassified.

q: How much is the Plus plan?
answer: The Plus plan costs $4 per month, which is charged annually to save 20%.

q: What's the price of Team for 5 people per month?
answer: The Team plan costs $8 per user per month. For 5 people, the monthly cost would be $40.

q: How many notes can I keep on the free plan?
answer: On the free plan, you can keep up to 100 notes.

q: Can I get my money back? I bought Plus 10 days ago.
answer: I don't know the refund policy for your specific situation. You can open a support ticket and I'll be happy to help you with that. Please provide your order number so I can assist you further.

q: I bought Plus three weeks ago. Can I still get a refund?
answer: I don't know. You can contact support with your order number to see if you're eligible for a refund.

q: Is there an app for Linux?
answer: There is no desktop app for Linux, but you can use the web app on any modern web browser.

q: Does it run on Android 11?
answer: No, Example Notes requires Android 12 or later to run.

q: Can I use the web version without internet?
answer: No, you cannot use the web version of Example Notes without an internet connection. The web app requires a connection to sync your notes and access features.

q: How do I export everything as PDF?
answer: To export all your notes as PDF, go to Settings > Export, select "Export all notes" and then choose "PDF" as the export format. The PDF file will be emailed to you as a ZIP file.

q: I deleted a note by mistake yesterday. Help!
answer: I'm here to help. To restore your deleted note, please go to the Trash in Example Notes, select the note you want to restore, and click "Restore".

q: Can I use SMS codes for two-factor authentication?
answer: No, we do not support SMS codes for two-factor authentication. You can use an authenticator app instead.

q: What's the max attachment size on the free plan?
answer: On the Free plan, the maximum attachment size is 25 MB per file.

q: If I cancel today, do I lose Plus immediately?
answer: If you cancel your Plus subscription today, you will lose access to Plus features immediately, but you'll still have access to your notes until the end of the current billing period.

q: Where do you store my notes?
answer: We store your notes in AWS data centers in the United States, encrypted at rest and in transit.

q: How long does support take to reply?
answer: We aim to reply to all support emails within one business day.

q: Is there a discount if I pay yearly?
answer: Yes, if you pay annually, you save 20% on your subscription.

q: How many devices can I use with Plus?
answer: With Plus, you can use up to 3 devices.

q: Do you offer a student discount?
answer: I don't know. Example Notes does offer an annual billing discount, but I'm not aware of a student discount. If you're interested in learning more, I recommend opening a support ticket.

q: Is Example Notes HIPAA compliant?
answer: I don't know and would be happy to open a support ticket for you to discuss your specific HIPAA compliance needs with our team.

q: Can I import my notes from Evernote?
answer: I don't know how to import notes from Evernote into Example Notes. You can open a support ticket to ask for more information on how to import notes from other note-taking apps.

q: When will the Linux desktop app be released?
answer: I don't know and can't provide information on the Linux desktop app. If you're interested in using Example Notes on Linux, I suggest opening a support ticket to ask about our web app, which is available for Linux users.

answer: Open the Trash, select the note, and click "Restore".

answer: The Team plan ($8 per user per month) offers shared workspaces and admin controls.

q: And on the paid plans?
answer: On Plus and Team plans, you can attach files up to 250 MB per file.

q: I only bought it 5 days ago. Can I get the money back instead?
answer: You can get a refund for the Plus subscription within 14 days of purchase. Please contact support with your order number so we can assist you with the refund.

q: パスワードを忘れました。どうすればいいですか？
answer: Forgot passwordなので、Sign-inページで「Forgot password」をクリックしてください。パスワードリセットのリンクが送られますが、30分以内には有効でないため、速やかにリセットしてください。
